---
title: "06 — Two-by-two coupled suspension (MIMO)"
---

Real suspensions do not move one degree of freedom at a time: a length (POS) drive leaks
into pitch (PIT) and vice-versa. The honest model is a **2×2 transfer-function matrix**

$$
\begin{bmatrix} y_{\text{POS}} \\ y_{\text{PIT}} \end{bmatrix}
=
\begin{bmatrix} H_{11} & H_{12} \\ H_{21} & H_{22} \end{bmatrix}
\begin{bmatrix} u_{\text{POS}} \\ u_{\text{PIT}} \end{bmatrix},
$$

with the off-diagonal terms the cross-coupling. We identify the whole matrix the standard
MIMO way — **one input at a time**: drive input $j$ with a periodic multisine, measure
*both* outputs, and the leakage-free reference-based FRF gives column $j$. Each of the four
elements gets the **full diagnostic set**; the magnitude/phase/coherence matrices are up
top, the per-element detail is in the tabs.

```{python}
#| code-summary: "Setup — true 2×2 plant, twin with coupling, priors"
import sys, pathlib
_p = pathlib.Path.cwd()
for _c in [_p, *_p.parents]:
    for _d in (_c, _c / "docs"):
        if (_d / "sysid_plots.py").exists() and str(_d) not in sys.path:
            sys.path.insert(0, str(_d))

import numpy as np
import plotly.graph_objects as go
from plotly.subplots import make_subplots
import sysid_plots as sp
from sysid_campaign import param_sigmas

from system_ident.backends.twin import TwinBackend
from system_ident.plant import SuspensionPlant
from system_ident.model import TFModel
from system_ident.excitation import multisine_from_psd
from system_ident.loop import SysIDLoop
from system_ident.estimators.gml import GMLEstimator
from system_ident.fisher import fisher_matrix
from system_ident.design.pintelon import optimal_excitation, prior_robust_excitation

FS, NPERSEG, N_PERIODS = 32.0, 2048, 8
TOTAL = NPERSEG * N_PERIODS / FS
ACT_LIMIT = 1000.0
INPUTS = ["POS", "PIT"]
ELEMS = [("POS", "POS"), ("PIT", "POS"), ("POS", "PIT"), ("PIT", "PIT")]
ECOLOR = {("POS", "POS"): sp.SKY, ("PIT", "PIT"): sp.GOLD,
          ("PIT", "POS"): sp.ROSE, ("POS", "PIT"): sp.GREEN}

TRUE = {("POS", "POS"): TFModel.from_resonances([(0.8, 20.0)], 100.0),
        ("PIT", "PIT"): TFModel.from_resonances([(1.4, 25.0)],  80.0),
        ("PIT", "POS"): TFModel.from_resonances([(0.8, 20.0)],  25.0),
        ("POS", "PIT"): TFModel.from_resonances([(1.4, 25.0)],  15.0)}
PRIOR = {("POS", "POS"): TFModel.from_resonances([(1.0, 15.0)], 130.0),
         ("PIT", "PIT"): TFModel.from_resonances([(1.7, 18.0)], 110.0),
         ("PIT", "POS"): TFModel.from_resonances([(1.0, 15.0)],  35.0),
         ("POS", "PIT"): TFModel.from_resonances([(1.7, 18.0)],  22.0)}

plant = SuspensionPlant({"POS": TRUE[("POS", "POS")], "PIT": TRUE[("PIT", "PIT")]}, FS)
coupling = {("PIT", "POS"): TRUE[("PIT", "POS")], ("POS", "PIT"): TRUE[("POS", "PIT")]}
exc = {"POS": "C1:EXC_POS", "PIT": "C1:EXC_PIT"}
rsp = {"POS": "C1:RSP_POS", "PIT": "C1:RSP_PIT"}
tw = TwinBackend(plant, {c: d for d, c in exc.items()}, {c: d for d, c in rsp.items()},
                 fs=FS, sensor_asd=2e-3, coupling=coupling)

f_all = np.fft.rfftfreq(NPERSEG, 1 / FS)
band = (f_all >= 0.1) & (f_all <= 5.0); freq = f_all[band]
Pyy, Px_tot = np.ones_like(freq), 1.0
```

```{python}
#| code-summary: "Run 3 passes, one input column at a time"
est = GMLEstimator()
model = {k: PRIOR[k] for k in ELEMS}
hist = {k: [] for k in ELEMS}
accum = {k: {"w": np.zeros(len(freq)), "wH": np.zeros(len(freq), complex)} for k in ELEMS}
info = {k: np.zeros((PRIOR[k].num.size + PRIOR[k].den.size - 1,) * 2) for k in ELEMS}
col = {j: [] for j in INPUTS}            # per-column safety + pass-0 time series
rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
zero = np.zeros(int(round(TOTAL * FS)))

for p in range(3):
    for j in INPUTS:                     # drive column j from its diagonal model
        diag = model[(j, j)]
        Pxx = (prior_robust_excitation(freq, diag, Pyy, Px_tot, 0.5, n_iter=6)
               if p == 0 else optimal_excitation(freq, diag, Pyy, Px_tot, n_iter=6))
        for kk in INPUTS:
            tw.inject(exc[kk], zero, FS)
        drive = multisine_from_psd(Pxx, FS, NPERSEG, N_PERIODS, freq, seed=rng)
        tw.inject(exc[j], drive, FS)
        seg = tw.read([exc[j], rsp["POS"], rsp["PIT"]], TOTAL)
        tw.inject(exc[j], zero, FS)
        col[j].append(dict(**{"pass": p + 1}, drive=seg[exc[j]],
                           resp={i: seg[rsp[i]] for i in INPUTS},
                           peak=float(np.max(np.abs(seg[exc[j]]))),
                           rms=float(np.std(seg[rsp[j]]))))
        for i in INPUTS:                 # both outputs -> elements (i, j)
            key = (i, j)
            Hh, He, coh = SysIDLoop._estimate_tf_periodic(seg[exc[j]], seg[rsp[i]],
                                                          FS, NPERSEG, band)
            Hacc, eacc = SysIDLoop._accumulate(accum[key], Hh, He)
            model[key] = est.fit(freq, Hacc, eacc, model[key])
            info[key] = info[key] + fisher_matrix(freq, model[key], Pxx, Pyy, TOTAL)
            cov = np.linalg.inv(info[key])
            hist[key].append(dict(**{"pass": p + 1}, H=Hh, H_err=He, coh=coh,
                mask=np.isfinite(He), H_acc=Hacc, err_acc=eacc, model=model[key],
                cov=cov, frac=SysIDLoop._frac_uncertainty(model[key], cov)))
fit = {k: model[k] for k in ELEMS}
```

## Parameters recovered — all four elements

```{python}
#| code-summary: "Prior → fit → true for every element"
rows = []
for k in ELEMS:
    (f0p, qp) = sp.f0_q(PRIOR[k]); (f0t, qt) = sp.f0_q(TRUE[k]); (f0f, qf) = sp.f0_q(fit[k])
    rows.append([f"H[{k[0]}←{k[1]}]", f"{f0p:.2f}/{qp:.0f}", f"{f0f:.2f}/{qf:.1f}",
                 f"{f0t:.2f}/{qt:.0f}"])
sp.param_table(["element", "prior f₀/Q", "fit f₀/Q", "true f₀/Q"], rows,
               caption="Recovered modes (Hz / Q) — diagonal and cross terms")
```

## Is the drive gentle? — time series (POS driven)

```{python}
#| code-summary: "Drive (POS) + both outputs, first ~64 s of pass 1"
c0 = col["POS"][0]
t = np.arange(int(64 * FS)) / FS
sp.timeseries(t, [("drive (POS)", c0["drive"], sp.SKY)],
    [("POS motion (direct)", c0["resp"]["POS"], sp.GOLD),
     ("PIT motion (cross-coupling)", c0["resp"]["PIT"], sp.ROSE)],
    titles=["<b>Drive</b> — POS actuator (Schroeder multisine)",
            "<b>Mirror motion</b> — both DoFs respond"]).show()
```

## The 2×2 matrix — magnitude, phase, coherence

```{python}
#| code-summary: "Helper: a 2×2 matrix of any per-element quantity"
def matrix(kind, height=560):
    fig = make_subplots(rows=2, cols=2, shared_xaxes=True,
        subplot_titles=[f"H[{i}←{j}]" for i in INPUTS for j in INPUTS],
        vertical_spacing=0.11, horizontal_spacing=0.09)
    for r, i in enumerate(INPUTS):
        for c, j in enumerate(INPUTS):
            key = (i, j); h = hist[key][-1]; mask = h["mask"]; lead = (r == 0 and c == 0)
            if kind == "coh":
                fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=freq[mask], y=np.asarray(h["coh"])[mask],
                    mode="markers", marker=dict(color=sp.SKY, size=sp.MK_DATA),
                    showlegend=False), row=r + 1, col=c + 1)
                continue
            fn = (lambda H: np.abs(H)) if kind == "mag" else \
                 (lambda H: np.unwrap(np.angle(H)) * 180 / np.pi)
            fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=freq, y=fn(TRUE[key].eval(freq)), mode="lines",
                line=dict(color=sp.SKY, width=2.3), name="true", legendgroup="t",
                showlegend=lead), row=r + 1, col=c + 1)
            fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=freq[mask], y=fn(h["H_acc"])[mask], mode="markers",
                marker=dict(color=sp.GRAY, size=sp.MK_SMALL), name="measured",
                legendgroup="m", showlegend=lead), row=r + 1, col=c + 1)
            fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=freq, y=fn(fit[key].eval(freq)), mode="lines",
                line=dict(color=sp.GOLD, width=1.9, dash="dash"), name="ML fit",
                legendgroup="f", showlegend=lead), row=r + 1, col=c + 1)
    ylab = {"mag": "|G(f)|", "phase": "phase [deg]", "coh": "coherence γ²"}[kind]
    fig.update_xaxes(type="log"); fig.update_xaxes(title_text="Frequency [Hz]", row=2)
    if kind == "mag":
        fig.update_yaxes(type="log")
    if kind == "coh":
        fig.update_yaxes(range=[0, 1.02])
    fig.update_yaxes(title_text=ylab, col=1)
    return sp.style(fig, height=height)

matrix("mag").show()
```

```{python}
#| code-summary: "Phase matrix"
matrix("phase").show()
```

```{python}

matrix("coh", height=460).show()
```

```{python}
#| code-summary: "Drive peak & RMS vs the actuator limit, per column"
for j in INPUTS:
    sp.saturation([{"pass": c["pass"], "peak": c["peak"], "rms": c["rms"]} for c in col[j]],
                  limit=ACT_LIMIT).show()
```

## Per-element detail

```{python}
#| code-summary: "Helper: bode / residuals / recovery / overlay for one element"
def show_elem(key):
    h = hist[key]; mask = h[-1]["mask"]; final = fit[key]
    sp.bode(freq, [
        dict(name="true", H=TRUE[key].eval(freq), color=sp.SKY, width=2.6),
        dict(name="measured (±σ)", H=h[-1]["H_acc"], color=sp.GRAY, mode="markers",
             err=h[-1]["err_acc"], mask=mask),
        dict(name="prior", H=PRIOR[key].eval(freq), color=sp.RED, dash="dot"),
        dict(name="ML fit", H=final.eval(freq), color=sp.GOLD, dash="dash"),
    ], coh=h[-1]["coh"], coh_mask=mask).show()
    resid = ((h[-1]["H_acc"] - final.eval(freq)) / h[-1]["err_acc"]).real
    sp.residuals(freq, resid, mask).show()
    (f0p, qp) = sp.f0_q(PRIOR[key]); (f0t, qt) = sp.f0_q(TRUE[key]); (f0f, qf) = sp.f0_q(final)
    sig = param_sigmas(final, h[-1]["cov"])
    sp.parameter_recovery([
        dict(label="f₀ [Hz]", prior=f0p, fit=f0f, true=f0t, sigma=sig["f0"]),
        dict(label="Q", prior=qp, fit=qf, true=qt, sigma=sig["Q"]),
        dict(label="DC gain", prior=sp.dc_gain(PRIOR[key]), fit=sp.dc_gain(final),
             true=sp.dc_gain(TRUE[key]), sigma=sig["gain"], log=True),
    ]).show()
    sp.pass_overlay(freq, [dict(meas_mag=np.abs(x["H"]),
        fit_mag=np.abs(x["model"].eval(freq)), mask=x["mask"]) for x in h],
        np.abs(TRUE[key].eval(freq))).show()
```

::: {.callout-note}
## One input at a time recovers the whole matrix
Each single-input injection gives one *column*: drive POS, read both DoFs → $H_{11}, H_{21}$;
drive PIT → $H_{12}, H_{22}$. Because the multisine is periodic and the FRF is the
reference-based ratio-of-averages, every element is leakage-free, so even the small cross
terms (4–6× below the diagonal) are recovered to a percent. The digital twin applies the
coupling for real — driving POS genuinely moves pitch — so this is the same code path a
real MIMO measurement would use.
:::
